title: Length-prefixed record parser: unchecked copy into a fixed stack buffer

pov.description: first byte 0xFF (declared length 255) followed by 255 payload bytes

pass_criteria: shared unit tests pass on both the vulnerable and fixed builds
PoV aborts the vulnerable build under AddressSanitizer
PoV exits cleanly on the fixed build
expected_fix: bounds-check the declared length against sizeof(buf) and against the remaining input length before memcpy
agent_task: Given only the vulnerable build and its (passing) unit tests, find the memory-safety bug reachable from parse_record, produce an input that triggers it, and submit a patch that makes verify.sh report VERIFIED.
